## Security verdict: PASS

PR #198, exact head `534221808135ed39b3927d189505f38b73cebbe5`.

All four PRD/workstream JSON and committed Markdown files and their complete diff were privacy-reviewed under C19/C21. No private owner/name identity, private content, machine-local path, secret or unsafe export was identified.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No vulnerability or disclosure identified | - |

PRD req-03/req-10 records daemon-derived exemptions, the dropped provenance requirement and permanent C32 residuals while retaining contradiction guards, closed grammars and safe rendering (`docs/project/prds/003-seat-permissions.dd.json:105`; `.dd.md:63`).

Workstream goal/s01/s03/s04 records the abandoned provenance step, removed dependency and derived-only exemptions while preserving the inventory sensor/workshop (`docs/project/workstreams/003-seat-permissions.dd.json:17`; `.dd.md:22`). JSON and committed renders agree in the reviewed changes; no runtime security behavior changes.

GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42536606434` and Delivers run `42536606396` both identify this SHA and success.

No local rendering, validation, tests, builds, credential reads or mutations were performed.
